title: Memories stream event (plaintext payload)
description: docs/mesh-design.md §3, lot P0. The JSON sealed inside a vault event of the memories stream (header kind 'memory' or 'tombstone', matching `type`; conversation_id = the memories stream id; see memory-lww-vectors.json for the ids, the HLC, the content hash and the merge rules; reference: src/vault/contracts.ts readMemoryEvent and mergeMemories). Exactly these fields: anything else (a path, a source_ref) makes the event invalid and it takes no part in the merge. Draft-07 so that Fastify's Ajv compiles it as is.
$comment: Local mapping: memories.kind as is; memories.source 'manual' → manual, 'conversation' → learned, an import → import; superseded_by_id → superseded_by (a memory id of the stream). source_ref, entity_type, entity_id stay on the computer.

hlc.description: Hybrid logical clock '<wall>-<counter>': Unix ms on 13 digits, counter on 4; string order is clock order.

id.description: Random UUID v4 for manual/import; for learned, the keyed id of the content hash (memory-lww-vectors.json learned_ids).
